title: Underbaked, Umami Polish Rye Bake
description: A dense, sour, and cozy Polish dish featuring the umami flavor of ssamjang, perfectly suited for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Mix the rye flour, caraway seeds, and salt in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the ssamjang, molasses, and water.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into a round loaf and place it on a slate tile.
Brush the top of the loaf with vegetable oil.
Bake the loaf in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
Remove the loaf from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Cut the loaf in half and serve with your favorite Polish sides.
